summary: Red-phase test-writing run for issue #5 (replace hand-written API layer with generated OpenAPI Swift client). 25 permanent XCTest cases committed across three files: (1) OpenAPISpecConformanceTests - 13 unguarded tests that assert the vendored OpenAPI document (expected at iOS/Sources/ColorMatchingAPI/openapi.json) exactly matches the API published by viamin/color_matching#113 (paths, methods, operationIds, bearerAuth, schema component shapes, compatibility-version enums); they fail today because the document is not vendored yet. (2) OpenAPIGeneratorWiringTests - 6 unguarded tests asserting Package.swift declares swift-openapi-generator + swift-openapi-runtime, a ColorMatchingAPI generated target, dependency wiring into ColorMatchingLPSAppCore and the test target, checked-in generator config, and removal of the hand-written transport DTOs; all fail today. (3) GeneratedClientStubbedResponseTests - 7 tests exercising every app-facing operation of the generated client against an in-memory ClientTransport (no live server), guarded by #if canImport(ColorMatchingAPI) so the suite compiles at red phase and activates automatically once the generated target exists. Contract deltas between docs/color-matching-api-contract.md and the published spec are recorded in docs/ios-openapi-generated-client-plan.md for the implementation PR description. No Swift toolchain exists in this container, so no test could be executed locally; swift test --disable-sandbox is deferred to CI / the implementation run, where the unguarded tests are expected to fail (red phase) until the generated client lands.
